summary: apt_key returns key ids before and after changes, the fingerprint, source id, calculated key id and short id.
questions: How can I see which apt keys existed before the change?
What's the difference between id and key_id in apt_key results?

answer_card.title: apt_key return values
answer_card.answer_md:
- `before` (always) / `after` (on change): key ids/fingerprints
- `fp`: fingerprint imported
- `id`: key id from source; `key_id`: calculated id (usually the same); `short_id`: short id
